description: Assess DeFi protocol health: combines TVL, utilization rates, and liquidation frequency into a composite health score (0-100). Use for protocol-level DeFi health and stress signals on one chain. It does not rank yields or inspect a token contract; use defi.aggregator for cross-chain lending rankings, defi.compare for protocol rates, or token.risk for token risk.

chain.description: EVM chain only. Supported chains: base, ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bsc, avalanche, zksync, linea, scroll, blast, mantle, gnosis, polygon-zkevm, mode, sei, celo, manta, taiko, fantom, cronos, opbnb, zora, worldchain, metis, fraxtal, kava, zetachain, filecoin, core-dao, aurora, moonbeam, klaytn, bob, canto, monad, tempo, megaeth, arc, plasma, katana, robinhood, pharos, hyperevm.

name: defi.health
title: Protocol Health
